title: Perfect Acceptance of an Encoded Quadratic Proof
statement: For every positive integer $n$ and every Boolean word $w$ of length $n$, the quadratic input consistency tester accepts with probability $1$ when given the word formed by concatenating $w$ with the encoded homogeneous quadratic proof of the binary vector corresponding to $w$.
